strings.name: Steffi Graf
strings.summary: Coached initially by her father, Graf developed an attacking forehand, sliced backhand and exceptional movement. In 1988 she won all four major singles titles and Olympic gold, finishing her career with 22 majors and 377 weeks at No.1. She retired in 1999 and has supported her Children for Tomorrow foundation, providing psychological help for children affected by war and displacement.
